messages:
kevin: Heads-up — I'm about to land a small TF change that adds an ExternalSecret annotation to trigger our cert-rotation job for the signer certs in staging. Need a quick sanity check before I apply.

sarah: :eyes: can you paste the exact ExternalSecret / TF snippet you'll be adding?

kevin: Sure — here's the ExternalSecret shape I'm planning (Helm values / rendered YAML):
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: signer-tls
  namespace: staging
  annotations:
    redwood.com/rotation-trigger: jobs/cert-rotate-signer
spec:
  refreshInterval: "5m"
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: signer-tls
    template:
      type: kubernetes.io/tls
  data:
  - secretKey: tls.crt
    remoteRef:
      key: secret/data/services/signer
      property: certificate
  - secretKey: tls.key
    remoteRef:
      key: secret/data/services/signer
      property: private_key
```
And the TF change is just an annotations map on the module: `annotations = { "redwood.com/rotation-trigger" = "jobs/cert-rotate-signer" }`

raj: Quick notes — for Vault KV v2 you DO need the `secret/data/...` path (looks correct) and use `property` for the inner field. Confirmed. Also refreshInterval=5m is fine but avoid <1m.

maria: Will the rotation job cause a downtime for pods mounting the secret? Our workloads use projected volumes and don't auto-restart on secret update.

kevin: The rotation job will write the k8s Secret. We don't expect pods to crash, but they won't pick up the new cert unless they re-read or are restarted. Plan is the rotation job will also patch deployment's pod template with `redwood.com/last-rotated: <ts>` to force a rollout. Example the job will run: `kubectl patch deploy signer --namespace staging -p '{"spec": {"template": {"metadata": {"annotations": {"redwood.com/last-rotated": "2025-12-01T12:34:56Z"}}}}}'`

sarah: Good. Two extra checks: 1) ensure the rotation job SA has `secrets:update` (and patch) RBAC, 2) the ExternalSecrets controller RBAC has read on the Vault path.

kevin: Yep — added SA binding in the TF module: `resource "kubernetes_cluster_role_binding" "rotate-job-sa" { ... }`. Running a plan now.

devops-bot: terraform plan for module.externalsecret_annotations completed — no drift detected (plan id: plan-8f3d).

raj: Also validate the ExternalSecret controller version supports `property` mapping and `template.type: kubernetes.io/tls` — newer controllers are fine but we had a cluster with v0.6 where JSONPath was slightly different. Maybe run `kubectl get externalsecret signer-tls -n staging -o yaml` after apply to confirm mapping.

maria: And add a short smoke check in the rotation job that hits the service endpoint to sanity-validate the new cert before annotating deployment. Saves a failed rollout.

kevin: Good call — I'll add a curl check in the job and only patch the deployment on success.

sarah: One more nit: consider annotating the TF change with `apply:manual` in the PR description so oncall knows it's a rotation-critical change.

kevin: Will do. Holding the PR for 15m in case anyone wants to poke. If no blockers I'll merge and run `terraform apply`. ping me here if you want to review the plan. :thumbsup:
